mapping_corrections_confirmed.auction_only_price_mirror: price and fixed_asking_price both NULL; current_bid_price holds the bid
mapping_corrections_confirmed.minimum_price_to_bid_never_read: no column takes its value; reserve stays UNKNOWN

shipping_rules.FIXED + 0.00: KNOWN, 0.0 - the only representation that proves free shipping

query_strategy.reason: 333,296 results in one 24-hour window is 33x the 10,000 paging ceiling, so a band is required to page any slice exhaustively; the band is derived from researched-candidate comp coverage, not invented to satisfy the API
query_strategy.price_currency_rule: emitted only alongside a price clause; never alone
query_strategy.no_band_fallback: omit priceCurrency, enforce USD via db.is_usd in the application layer
query_strategy.warnings_policy: fetch_listings.assert_query_accepted raises QueryRejected on any warning or error

capacity_plan.window: frozen at run start T0 .. T0+24h, timezone-aware UTC
capacity_plan.band_justification: every $50-$1000 bucket resolved >=1 accepted comp for 78-100% of its researched candidates; 135 of 153 researched candidates fall inside it
capacity_plan.over_ceiling_behavior: geometric split until under 10,000; a band still over the ceiling at minimum width is returned as excluded and never queried - never truncated
capacity_plan.band_selection: evenly spaced by index across the full range, never an ascending prefix, so the pilot does not spend itself on the cheapest sub-bands
capacity_plan.candidate_selection: sorted by end_time then item_id; never by price or apparent attractiveness
capacity_plan.deduplication: against existing listings.item_id and against already researched identities, plus within-run identity collapse
capacity_plan.coverage_claim: 60 auction candidates sampled from $50.00-$755.14 across a single 24-hour ending window, bounded by a 60-candidate cap. It sampled 10 of 64 sub-bands, so parts of the range were never queried. This is not a representative sample of the 24-hour auction market and no market-wide conclusion may be drawn from it.

reserve_policy.allows: a clearly labelled PROVISIONAL research result only
